title: Writing --- Four Lines, And The Joiner That Is Not A Word
label: ch:ar-arbaa-sutur
canDo: I can write four connected lines of Arabic to a named reader, attaching the and-joiner to the following word and giving a reason with the because-word.

payoff.summary: Complete AR-W04-arbaa-sutur: four lines to one reader, at least one joined with the attached and-letter and one reasoned, then check no space follows it.
payoff.note: Arabic's and is a proclitic: it is written onto the front of the next word with no space. So the join is not a word the eye can skip on its way to the content -- it is a letter the following word now begins with, and a space after it leaves a letter belonging to nothing.
